rationale: Sylvester's security expertise and Philip's embedded systems work on IoT devices represent a natural complement—smart home and monitoring systems built on ESP32 platforms need security-focused design from the ground up. Philip's hands-on C++ and hardware experience combined with Sylvester's cybersecurity and security-research background could explore practical threat modeling and secure implementation in IoT projects.
intro_message: Sylvester Reagan, meet Philip Nisevich — he's building ESP32-based IoT devices and could benefit from your security research perspective to help secure smart home systems from the start.
